task_id.description: Task that produced this classification (e.g. EXT-003).

topic.description: Human-readable topic label shared by the classified units.

overlap_type.description: Relationship between the pieces of evidence named in ku_ids. Pair-level semantics (ADR-0009); stored separately from any KU disposition per docs/KNOWLEDGE_AND_PROVENANCE.md section 7.

ku_ids.description: Knowledge-unit ids participating in this relationship. Cross-checks require >= 2 distinct vaults (source_id prefixes).

rationale.description: Why this overlap_type was assigned; required for every classification, not only Superseded.

quote.description: Byte-exact excerpt fragment supporting the decision.

lines.description: Source line number(s) the quote comes from.

evidence.description: At least one quoted fragment per classification side; evidence must be verifiable against committed KU batches.

candidate_ref.description: Reference to the candidate-discovery run/report that surfaced the pair (provenance).

classified_by.description: Who/what assigned the classification (agent session, task, method).

method.description: How the decision was reached (e.g. 'CAP-013 candidates + orchestrator excerpt review').

supersedes_classification_id.description: Optional: earlier classification this record replaces (append-only corrections; the superseded record is never edited or deleted).

review.description: Optional independent-review verdict (attached by a later review record, not by self-review).
